summary.headline: Software Engineer & Data Science Researcher
summary.about: Computer Science student at Minnesota State University with experience in full-stack development, machine learning, and research. Passionate about creating innovative solutions that bridge technology and real-world applications.

bullets: Implemented a full-stack web app for the Student Government to manage voting and legal appointment scheduling, serving 80+ active users.
Integrated a real-time calendar system using FullCalendar and Pusher to sync availability and appointment updates.
Built a role-based access for 5 distinct user types: students, senate members, senate speaker, attorney, and super admin with tailored permissions and interfaces.
Designed an ETL pipeline to create a facial image dataset for Butterfly Malar Rash (BMR) detection.
Developed CNN models using transfer learning for BMR detection, achieving 91% accuracy.
Co-authored a peer-reviewed research paper on early detection of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus, published by IEEE.
Provided end-to-end technical support and troubleshooting for hardware and software issues, achieving a 98% customer satisfaction rate and reducing support ticket response time by 30%.
Maintained system reliability with 99.7% uptime, ensuring an uninterrupted and seamless user experience.

projects.name: SAFEHR – Simulation EHR
projects.summary: Built a web app used by MNSU Nursing department to help nursing students explore patient data and practice clinical decision-making.
bullets: Created an interactive genogram and ecomap editor with drag-and-drop, relationship lines, notes, and PNG/JSON export, used in 10+ case scenarios.

projects.name: NutriFitBot – AI Nutrition Chatbot
projects.summary: Built an AI chatbot that provides meal guidance and macro breakdowns for quick, reliable nutrition answers.
bullets: Added Gemini-powered reasoning with streaming replies and a responsive chat UI.
Improved clarity and speed of responses, reducing user effort compared to searching multiple sites.

projects.name: E-Commerce Marketplace
projects.summary: Built a full-stack marketplace that enables product browsing, cart management, and checkout.
bullets: Delivered a typed React frontend with a clean REST API to keep features reliable and easy to extend.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Minor in Mathematics
